correctedCritiques.pro-brainless-mind-idealist-account: Strongest feature: The reply correctly separates brain-mind correlation from logical proof of physical causation and offers an idealist model in which that systematic correspondence is expected. Principal limitation: Compatibility alone establishes no comparative advantage, while brains as extrinsic appearances remain too underspecified to explain interventions, patterned dependence, neurological impairment, and causal regularities. Live burden: Jones must derive testable consequences from the appearance account and show why idealism predicts brain-consciousness dependence at least as well as material production, rather than merely redescribing the correlation. Locked score: The mixed band reflects a coherent, calibrated compatibility response with direct subsidiary relevance, balanced against modest evidence, unstable terminology, incomplete contact with the decisive identification burden, and underestimation of systematic intervention's evidential force.
